messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for synth check: synth-eu-west-1-ml-prober failed 5/5 checks. PDINC12345 created. severity: warning. automated runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/synth-failure

pagerduty-bot: PDINC12345 assigned to oncall-eu (maria). Escalation policy: 3m -> senior-oncall.

maria (oncall-eu): acked PDINC12345 :white_check_mark: taking initial triage. Can someone check if this is probe-only or user-impacting?

jordan (eng-runtime): I'm pulling probe logs now. early guess: prober is hitting 429s from prober-collector ipset. Not yet seeing user 5xx.

alex (sre): see metrics: slight bump in 5xx on inference-vmpool-eu1 around the same window (10s spike). Could be backpressure.

maria (oncall-eu): copying runbook: disabling prober fanout to reduce traffic while we triage. command: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/prober/disable_fanout?synth=synth-eu-west-1`

jordan (eng-runtime): logs (filtered):
```
2026-03-15T12:04:01Z prober[server] ERROR upstream=collector-01 429 Too Many Requests
2026-03-15T12:04:02Z prober[server] WARN retry_backoff=120ms
2026-03-15T12:04:03Z prober[server] ERROR upstream=collector-02 502 Bad Gateway
```

maria (oncall-eu): deployed a temporary throttle on prober -> collector (reduced concurrency from 50 -> 10). Patch applied via ops-api. Waiting 30s to observe.

incident-bot: auto-escalation suppressed (ack present). Next evaluation in 2m.

alex (sre): scanning network rules — noticed a recent churn in collector nat-rule set from a config push ~12:03 UTC. pushing a rollback to previous rule.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: `terraform apply -target=module.network.collector_nat -var='version=2026-03-15-0'` (plan OK -> apply).

maria (oncall-eu): metrics look better after throttle + rollback: probe failures drop to 1/5, inference 5xx spike abated. Confirming with traffic graphs.

jordan (eng-runtime): leaving a quick snippet for post-incident: check collector rate-limit config, increase token-bucket for prober if we re-enable fanout, and add a small jitter to prober retries to avoid thundering herd.

tanya (senior-oncall): joining. thanks for the handoff. i'm going to create a short follow-up ticket and schedule a postmortem with network and runtime teams.

maria (oncall-eu): handoff -> tanya (senior-oncall). I'm off primary, will still monitor for 20m then unassign. PDINC12345 status: acknowledged, mitigation applied, customer-impact: none detected (synthetic-only), potential risk: transient user latency previously observed but rolled back.

tanya (senior-oncall): noted. please add the prober run id + collector nat rule id to the ticket. i'll own the postmortem. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall-eu): added logs + runbook snippet to PDINC12345 and created Jira RED-789 for follow-up. leaving thread.

incident-bot: PDINC12345: resolution queued. please close when verified stable for 1 hour.
